title: Should You Block AI Crawlers? Check Which One Puts Your Name in the Answer.
meta_description: Blocking the training crawler does not change whether an AI assistant can name your business. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Perplexity each run separate robots for training, for search and for live fetches, and only one of the three decides whether you can appear in the answer.
secondary_keywords: does blocking gptbot remove you from chatgpt
